about: Benchmark for the ProcIntel agent on the real World Bank slice (KE, GH, NP, BD, VN). 'answer' items pass when the agent calls the expected tools and at least one sentence with the expected kind of source survives verification; 'abstain' items pass when no verified sentence makes the forbidden claim; 'refuse' items pass when the agent declines (policy screen or model).

items.question: We are about to tender USD 20m of rural road rehabilitation works in Kenya. What should we plan for?

Nepal: planning a USD 5m goods package (equipment) under Request for Bids. How long will it take to award and what has gone wrong before?
Bangladesh: a USD 50m water supply civil works contract is being prepared. What schedule and risks should the team plan for?
Vietnam: we plan a USD 30m urban infrastructure works package. What do past projects suggest about timing and risk?
